note: multi-head attention in graph (RESHAPE->BATCH_MATMUL adj_y->SoftMax->BATCH_MATMUL->RESHAPE, 3-D [heads,T,HD]); q/k/v/o weight tensors are [64,64]/[H,64] (flattened per-head layout); RMSNorm variant=mean; RoPE is NOT in the multi-head path (the single-head block covers RoPE)

multihead_noise_floor: measure with two consecutive e2e runs (NOTES §4)
